decision_scope: The current PQDT schedule and the assigned PSUB and IF candidates mapped from fourteen selected Pilot 004 known records.

criteria.reason: Two complete record-detail passes returned identical PSUB and IF assignments for all fourteen selected known records.
Two browse and Add-to-search passes validated 27 assigned or case-normalized labels. Assigned IF Architecture had no exact selectable label under either tested capitalization.
Every tested construction joined exact descriptors to its complete free-text block with OR.
All nine fresh free-text and augmented partition pairs returned the same complete ordered IDs. The schedule unions each contained 29 IDs.
No augmented-only record existed in any partition.
PQDT publishes no stable term IDs, vocabulary release, scope notes, hierarchy, or explosion state for these flat browse indexes.

rationale: The tested descriptor unions added no numeric PQDT document ID.
Several assigned labels were absent, generic, or unsuitable for a protocol block.
Mapped controlled terms covered only part of the selected known-record set and cannot replace free text.
Adoption would add query and local transport complexity without observed recall value.
prospective_translation: Retain the accepted bounded-wildcard NOFT schedule without a PSUB.EXACT or IF.EXACT supplement.
future_candidate_rule: A new descriptor or indexed term requires another assigned-record mapping and complete no-loss value comparison before adoption.
limitations: The test covers labels assigned to fourteen selected records and does not establish the value of every future PQDT label.
The selected records are known items for vocabulary testing and are not final screening decisions.
PQDT applies year precision. Records from 2026 still require exact-cutoff screening.
A pilot-local bridge relaxed the adapter's multiple-raw-field preflight guard. Exact source query echo and every normal strict capture check remained mandatory.
Pilot artifacts create no final-search union.
